summary: The commenter urges the FCC to maintain robust E‑Rate funding to ensure all students have access to necessary educational resources.

claims.argument: Maintaining E‑Rate funding ensures all students, regardless of location or learning model, can access essential educational resources.
claims.evidence_quote:
As a member of the Golden Eagle Charter School community, I urge the FCC to protect E-Rate funding for schools.

Many of our students learn through independent study and rely on internet connectivity
